scores.evidence: Both objectives are can-do statements, and each has 2 or more questions with objectiveId (o1: q1, q2, e1, e2; o2: q3, q4, e3, e4). But e4 (a command from an old article is not found) never asks the learner to use the checklist or decide what to add next, so it does not test o2. The create-level o1 is assessed only by selected-response items.

hook-b1 gives a concrete 3-sentence scenario (「初日にスキル（skill）5つとフック（hook）3つを一度に入れようとして、手が止まりました」) and hook-predict is an ungraded predict item tied to o1. The keyed answer 「CLAUDE.mdだけで始め」 is later contradicted when ex-steps ② and e1 add permission rules on day 1, and the lesson never explains why.

The prerequisites name lessons 1–10. dr-table has a 「学んだ回」 column that links each part back to the lesson that taught it. The only new term, きっかけ, is defined in dr-b1 and matches the glossary, and the recalled terms (スキル, フック, 権限ルール, プランモード, サブエージェント) link to glossary entries.

Sentence and paragraph lint passes and every section has a table, diagram or check. But two lesson-level budgets are broken: estMinutes is 23 against the contract's 8–20, and the brief's own count of body text is 2,440 JP chars including sc-list, against the 2,400 limit. The estimate also counts the self-check checklist as a third 2-minute hands-on task.

ex-steps has 5 steps with subgoal titles, the trigger (why) of each and an expect, followed by the full artefacts (ex-prompt-claude-md, ex-settings, ex-prompt-skill), all before practice-setup. But nothing says that the steps were added over time. Shown as one sequence, they look like the 「全部一度に」 setup that the hook warns against.

There are inline checks in 4 of the 5 content sections (q1–q4), at apply/evaluate level, with feedback on every wrong option. But q4's stem 「点検で、コンテキストの項目に当てはまりませんでした」 points the learner at self-check-list item sc-context 「作業の切れ目で /clear している」, so the answer can be found by matching words.

All 7 misconceptions from the brief map to distractors, each with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer (e.g. q2 b 「拒否すると、package.jsonを変えたときにも入れられなくなります」, q3 d about over-eager reviewers). But dr-b2 states the rule as 「CLAUDE.mdだけで始め」 without saying that safety rules are set on day 1, which creates a new misconception the lesson then contradicts.

cycle-flow has 5 nodes plus the review loop, Japanese labels that match the cycle-steps titles (「新しい目でレビューする」, 「差分を説明してもらう」), a caption that states the takeaway (「レビューで直す指摘があれば、実装と検証に戻る」) and full alt text. dr-table is a real comparison, and there are no decorative images.

The practice is an authentic transfer task in the learner's own repository. Steps have expect plus hint/troubleshoot, there are model answers (setup-prompt-model, setup-settings-model, cycle-prompt-plan with the expected plan), and self-check-list is the self-check. The hint ladder is uneven: c-review, c-explain and c-commit have neither hint nor troubleshoot.

The summary comes after the exam and has 4 points, followed by a reflection prompt (「自分で判断した場面を1行で書いておきましょう」) and a next step (「演習3で決めた部品を足していきましょう」). There are 7 flashcards and 3 askTutor suggestions.

Versions are pinned (subtitle v2.1.304; ex-steps ② v2.1.283) and the settings and hook code match the course's cc-02/cc-08. But e1 option c's feedback 「鍵の読み取りとpushを確実に止めるのは、権限ルールです」 overclaims: cc-02 teaches that 「`Read(./.env)` も、一部のコマンドやスクリプトの読み取りは止められません」 and that `git -C . push` does not match `Bash(git push *)`. Also, e3's 「公式の目安（200行以内）」 is not backed by any source in check-quiz.cite.

です・ます throughout, warm and non-pressuring (「なければ足しません」, 「迷ったときの考え方は？」), no banned phrases (lint clean), and terms are consistent with the glossary (確認ルール/拒否ルール as aliases). A few phrases read as translated, such as 「新しい目でレビューする」.

The single declared locale (jp) is complete, including the diagram labels. cycle-flow has descriptive alt text, the link text is specific (「公式ドキュメントの日本語版」, 「What's new」) and no text is baked into images.

mustFix.issue: estMinutes is 23, above the contract's 8–20 minutes. The brief's own count puts the body at 2,440 JP chars including sc-list, above the 2,400 limit. The estimate counts 3 practice tasks × 2 min, but self-check-list is the success-criteria checklist of the other two tasks, as the brief says, not a third hands-on task.
mustFix.fix: (1) Delete e4 from check-quiz (see the align item), leaving 8 questions × 40 s = 5.3 min. (2) Delete blocks sc-b3 and sc-list. Append 「Claude Codeは頻繁に更新されます。動かないときは、[公式ドキュメントの日本語版](https://code.claude.com/docs/ja/overview)で確かめましょう。」 to summary-next's md and add "cc-champion-kit" to its cite. Change card-update's back to 「公式ドキュメントの日本語版で、今の書き方を確かめる。」 Remove cc-whats-new and cc-common-workflows from sources if nothing else cites them. (3) Delete hook-b1's second paragraph 「最初に何をそろえるとよいでしょうか。予想してみましょう。」, because hook-predict's title and stem already ask it. (4) Delete the MCP row from dr-table. (5) Trim the model-answer prose: delete the second paragraph of ex-prompt-claude-md's expect; replace the second paragraph of setup-prompt-model's expect with 「CLAUDE.mdは19行です。個人のデータは、頼むだけでなく下の設定で読み取りを拒否しています。」; delete the 「今の仕組み：…表示しています。」 paragraph of cycle-prompt-plan's expect. (6) Recompute with the contract formula: 450 JP chars/min over body + prompt texts + flashcards, 40 s per question, and 2 min for each of the 2 hands-on tasks (practice-setup, practice-cycle). Body text, counting list items and the sentences added by the other fixes, must be ≤ 2,400. Set estMinutes to the result, which must be ≤ 20, and update the brief's Format and Measured lines.

mustFix.issue: e4 (「半年前の記事に書かれたコマンドを打つと、見つからないと表示されました」, objectiveId o2) tests keeping up with updates. It never asks the learner to evaluate their environment or working process against the checklist, or to decide what to add next, so it does not test o2. Neither objective covers this content.
mustFix.fix: Delete question e4 from check-quiz. o2 stays assessed by q3, q4 and the exam item e3, and the update advice stays in summary-next, summary point 4 and card-update.

mustFix.issue: The design rule says to start with CLAUDE.md only and add parts when a trigger repeats (dr-b1, hook-predict's answer b). Yet ex-steps ②, setup-steps p-rules and the keyed answer of e1 add deny and ask rules on day 1 with no repeated trouble. The lesson never says why, so a learner who applies the rule as taught would leave secrets unprotected until a leak happens twice. dr-b2 also calls the parts 「Claude Codeが強制する」 without the limit taught in cc-02.
mustFix.fix: Replace dr-b2's md with 「CLAUDE.mdとスキルは「お願い」で、保証はありません。Claudeの判断に任せず止めたいことは、フックと[[権限ルール]]（permission rule）に置きます。ただし、秘密情報の読み取りとpushは、1回で困るので、きっかけを待たずに初日から権限ルールで守ります。」 and add "cc-permissions" to dr-b2's cite. Append 「ただし、秘密情報とpushの守りは例外で、初日から置きます（次のセクション）。」 to pq0's explanation in hook-predict.

mustFix.issue: ex-steps presents the five additions as one setup sequence with no timeline. The worked example therefore looks like what the hook warns against (installing everything on day 1). Its own triggers (「整形を忘れることが続いたので」, 「作業のたびに…打っていたので」) only make sense after weeks of use.
mustFix.fix: Replace ex-b1's md with 「題材は、佐藤さんのToDoアプリ（Node.js、テストは `npm test`）です。①と②は初日に置き、③と④は、きっかけが起きた週に1つずつ足しました。」

mustFix.issue: e1 option c's feedback says 「鍵の読み取りとpushを確実に止めるのは、権限ルールです」 and e1's explanation says 「Claude Codeが強制します」. The course's cc-02 teaches that `Read(./.env)` does not stop some commands and scripts from reading the file, and that `git -C . push` does not match `Bash(git push *)`. The cc-06 review already removed this same overclaim.
mustFix.fix: Change e1 option c's feedback to 「スキルの中身も、Claudeへのお願いです。鍵の読み取りとpushを、Claudeの判断に任せず止めるのは権限ルールです。」 In e1's explanation, replace 「Claude Codeが強制します。」 with 「一致した操作を、Claudeの判断に関係なくClaude Codeが止めます。」

mustFix.issue: e3 option a's feedback cites a number, 「公式の目安（200行以内）」, but check-quiz.cite does not include the source that states it (cc-memory, How Claude remembers your project).

q4's stem opens with 「点検で、コンテキストの項目に当てはまりませんでした。」 This points the learner at self-check-list's sc-context label 「CLAUDE.mdは短く、作業の切れ目で /clear している」, a few blocks above, so option a can be picked by matching `/clear`. The learner never has to diagnose the problem.
mustFix.fix: Change q4's prompt to 「1つの会話でバグを直したあと、別の機能追加を続けています。Claudeが、前の作業の前提を混ぜ始めました。次にすることとして、最も合うのはどれでしょう？」 and change its hint to 「点検リストのどの観点の問題かを、まず考えましょう。」

niceToHave: c-plan (cycle-steps): the session starts in auto mode, so one Shift+Tab lands in Manual mode (cc-02, cc-03). Replace the first sentence of c-plan's md with 「Shift + Tabを、`⏸ plan mode on` と出るまで押して[[プランモード]]（plan mode）にし、下の依頼文を送ります。」

setup-steps: p-rules expects the rules in `/permissions` before p-restart says settings load after a restart. Change p-rules' expect to 「JSONとして正しく書けています。」 and p-restart's expect to 「`/context` にCLAUDE.mdが、`/permissions` に書いたルールが出ます。」
p-claude-md's 「25行以内」 is unexplained, while e3 a's feedback says 40 lines is fine under the official 200-line guide. Change p-claude-md's hint to 「最初は25行以内を目安にします。各行に「消したらまちがえる？」と聞きます。」
e1: option a is the longest and the only one that splits the three cases, which hints at the answer. Lengthen b to 「3つともCLAUDE.mdに「必ず」「絶対に」と書き、毎回読み込ませる」 and c to 「3つそれぞれにスキルを作り、作業の前に毎回呼び出す」.
c-review (cycle-steps) has no hint or troubleshoot. Add hint 「指摘が多すぎたら、計画の要件に関わるものだけに絞ってと頼みます。」
summary-points[1]: change 「必ず守らせたいことは、権限ルールとフックに置きます。」 to 「Claudeの判断に任せず止めたいことは、権限ルールとフックに置きます。」 to match the accuracy fix.
card-deny's back could add the limit from cc-02/cc-10: 「`permissions.deny` に `Read(./.env)` などの拒否ルールを書く。スクリプトが自分で開く読み取りは止まらない。」
Prerequisites: add 第2回 権限ルール and 第7回 スキル to the 「とくに」 list, because dr-table, ex-steps and e1/e2 depend on them.
ja-editor: 「新しい目でレビューする」 (cycle-flow, c-review, cycle-prompt-review title) reads as a translation of 'fresh eyes'. Consider 「別のコンテキストでレビューする」, which matches self-check-list's sc-review.
summary: The capstone is well built: a design rule that recalls earlier lessons (dr-table with 「学んだ回」), a worked example whose every step names its trigger, and two authentic practices with model answers and a self-check list. The most important fix is the core rule. As taught (「CLAUDE.mdだけで始め」), it contradicts the lesson's own day-1 deny/ask rules, and the exam overclaims that permission rules 「確実に止める」. State the safety exception and its limits in dr-b2 and ex-b1, then delete the off-objective e4, fix q4's give-away stem, add the missing cc-memory citation, and cut the lesson back within the 20-minute and 2,400-character budgets.
